title: Canonical models for strict quotient point transport
statement: For the finite-field datum D, a prime l and a finite extension E/Q_l, let P_n be the ordinary coefficient reduction of a complex P of completed integral sheaves [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. The integral sections functor and finite sections functor are those of [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport]. The identity-on-sections comparison of [def-trf-point-reduction-units] extends degreewise to an isomorphism e_K. Define the strict integral-linear chain map u_n(P) to be e_(P_n) followed by scalar restriction of finite sigma followed by Gamma(kappa), then e_(g_n^*P_n) inverse [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison]. Its canonical derived source comparison is Q(e_K) followed by the inverse scalar-restriction factor and the image of the inverse sections factor. Its canonical target comparison further uses the inverse pullback factor and the recorded intrinsic finite pullback isomorphism. The derived categories and additive restriction use their standard existing instances. These are the original strictQuotientPoint definitions moved without any signature or body change.
